title: Chapter 47 — Trade Psychology: How Trade Buyers Decide
intro: Decision psychology across the trade cast and where each buyer diverges.

sections.title: What All Trade Buyers Share
sections.content:
Every trade buyer values reliability over price. They cannot afford a supplier who creates problems — because every problem on a project delays the schedule, costs money, and damages their reputation with their client.

Price matters. But reliability, responsiveness, and accuracy matter more. The cheapest supplier who misses deliveries loses to the slightly more expensive supplier who never does.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating trade psychology understanding, ask:

Does the salesperson understand that trade buyers prioritize reliability over price?
Do they lead with service and consistency — or compete on price alone?
